The '''master''' of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Horoth Gendi]] was a member of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and bequeathed the [[Nikto Sector]], a region of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], to Gendi after the Nikto saved the Hutt's life in an act of quick-thinking violence. Gendi soon formed his [[Horoth Gendi's gang|own gang]] and ended his servitude to the Hutt.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horoth Gendi's master was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Nikto Sector in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
